predictions.title: Agentic-AI frameworks ship four-surface signed-load default by mid-June 2026
predictions.body: By mid-June 2026 the Thursday fourth-tier-surface adoption wave forces the agentic-AI framework cohort — LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack, and LiteLLM — to ship the paired four-surface mitigation (load-time signed-checkpoint plus runtime manifest-allowlist-validation plus workflow-state path-canonicalization plus intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization) as the documented default in the next minor-version release rather than as opt-in or sub-tier-only features. The Thursday catalysts are concrete, mutually reinforcing, and land within a single business day across all four surfaces simultaneously: LangChain CVE-2026-44967 (CVSS 8.8) drops as a path-traversal in the workflow-state checkpoint loader's intermediate hand-off serializer with v0.3.7 shipping same-day plus paired v0.2.x and v0.1.x backports the NHS England blocklist references; Trail of Bits publishes a Thursday addendum extending the Wednesday nine-CVE taxonomy to ten with intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization as a fresh sub-pattern, reaffirming the four-tier-and-sub-tier common-mitigation shape; the DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft Thursday v3 joint preprint addendum (arxiv 2605.06712v3) extends the runtime-verifier integration pattern to the intermediate-state-serializer with reference implementations in Python and Rust covering all ten CVE-pattern instances; Verifiable Intermediate-State-Serializer Canonicalization for Agentic AI Workflow-State Migration (arxiv 2605.06892) ships Thursday with formal compositional safety theorems for the four-tier-and-sub-tier load-runtime-workflow-state-intermediate-state loader pattern, with MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, INRIA France, and Tokyo Institute of Technology added to the institutional reviewer cohort; vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 plus SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8 plus Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1 each ship the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation on the same Thursday with vLLM additionally defaulting the signed-checkpoint loader and closing the parity gap to SGLang at 4.3 percent, the tightest gap since the benchmark cycle began; Unsloth ships the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation Thursday as the first local-LLM fine-tuning stack to cover the now-four-tier-and-sub-tier surface ahead of the framework cohort target; OpenAI Codex CLI v3.1.2 ships the matching client-side mitigation; and Microsoft, LangChain, the CrewAI maintainer team, the Pydantic AI maintainer team, plus the AutoGen maintainer team publish parallel Thursday commitments to ship the paired four-surface delivery as a default in the next minor-version release, extending the previously-coordinated mid-June default-shipment window to cover all four surfaces as one bundle. The structural force is that when ten CVE instances, one production-tier serving stack defaulting the signed-checkpoint loader, three serving stacks shipping the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation, one local-LLM fine-tuning stack shipping the same primitive, one client-side CLI shipping the matching mitigation, and the v3 runtime-verifier preprint with reference implementations in Python and Rust covering all ten CVE patterns all land on the same Thursday, the agentic-AI framework cohort cannot ship a partial three-surface mitigation in their next minor release while the CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft now incorporating the ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy clears interagency review into the OMB publication queue and treats four-surface signed-load posture as paired procurement-eligibility evidence. The most likely shape is the four-surface mitigation becoming the documented default in the next minor release of LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack, and LiteLLM — with paired backport advisories for the older branches the NHS England blocklist references and explicit unsigned-load opt-out flags for sandboxed test fixtures — within the mid-June 2026 window the maintainer cohort has now publicly committed to. Bear case is that one framework defers the intermediate-state-serializer sub-tier as a sub-minor patch release and ships only the three-surface bundle in its mid-June minor; absent that, mid-June 2026 lands the paired four-surface signed-load mitigation as the documented default across the agentic-AI framework cohort.

reasoning.because: Thursday LangChain CVE-2026-44967 + ten-CVE taxonomy; vLLM/SGLang/TGI/Unsloth ship the sub-tier.
reasoning.given: Maintainer cohort Thursday commitments extend mid-June default-shipment to all four surfaces.
reasoning.so_that: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack, LiteLLM ship four-surface mitigation as default.
reasoning.landing: By mid-June 2026; agentic-AI framework cohort; paired backport advisories.
reasoning.plain_language: Popular AI agent toolkits will all soon require four safety checks before loading any file, instead of just three.

predictions.summary: Thursday's LangChain CVE-2026-44967 surfaces a fourth mitigation tier; vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Unsloth, and Codex CLI ship the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation same day. By mid-June 2026 the agentic-AI framework cohort defaults the four-surface signed-load bundle in its next minor release.

predictions.title: Alphabet ships AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout by Q2 2026 print
predictions.body: By the fiscal Q2 2026 10-Q filing window Alphabet ships a discrete AI Services revenue and capex segment footnote — driven by the Thursday Mag-7 print-cycle preview cohort coordinated update lifting the Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability to 84 percent (from 78 percent Wednesday), with Goldman Sachs Equity Research joining the Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, and Jefferies preview cohort as a sixth coordinated voice and the May 21 Alphabet analyst day at T-minus-seven calendar days operating as the operative pricing event, combined with the Thursday SEC Division of Corporation Finance third sample comment letter on AI-services-revenue measurement basis (specifically addressing minimum-commit hyperscaler-anchor warrant true-up adjustments plus rev-share-pool earnout disclosure) paired with the Securities Act Forms staff guidance refresh on hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity counterparty disclosure shape, the now-three-consecutive-trading-day Cerebras CBRS consolidation pattern providing the operative AI-accelerator-revenue valuation comparable with Bernstein lifting its post-IPO price-target floor from $172 to $185 and the Saudi Aramco Digital MoU close timeline narrowing to the late-Q2 2026 window, and the Alphabet $9B incremental Iowa Gemini-cluster capex disclosure from the May 7 Q1 print remaining the leading-actor capex catalyst — forces a discrete AI Services revenue plus capex footnote disclosure in the Q2 10-Q rather than continued aggregation inside the Google Services or Google Cloud segment lines. The forcing function is that when six independent equity-research desks publish a coordinated 84 percent breakout probability one week before the analyst day, Corp Fin staff ship three sample comment letters plus a paired Securities Act Forms staff guidance refresh inside ten business days, and the Cerebras post-IPO valuation comparable holds three consecutive consolidation sessions with institutional buyside ratcheting to 35 percent of float, the Alphabet investor-relations and audit-committee posture cannot defer the breakout into the Q3 10-Q without inviting a Corp Fin comment letter against the Q2 filing under the Thursday-refreshed Securities Act Forms guidance shape. The most likely landing is a Q2 10-Q AI Services footnote (filed late-July 2026) covering AI-services revenue recognition basis (entailing usage-tiered hyperscaler-anchor contract treatment plus committed-purchase-order timing), incremental AI-infrastructure capex disclosure (entailing the Iowa Gemini-cluster $9B plus successor commitments), and a hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity counterparty footnote (entailing the Cerebras Apple supply agreement plus Anthropic-Blackstone JV templates as cross-vendor references) — with the May 21 analyst day pre-announcing the footnote shape ahead of the 10-Q filing. Microsoft, Meta, and AWS follow inside the fiscal Q3 2026 print window per the Thursday Wells Fargo plus Evercore plus Jefferies plus Goldman Sachs joint cohort note. Bear case is that Alphabet defers the breakout citing competitive-disclosure exemption and ships only an enhanced narrative MD&A paragraph; absent that, the Q2 2026 10-Q lands a discrete AI Services revenue and capex footnote on a structurally entailed timeline.

predictions.title: OECD GENAI cyber-eval reciprocity attestation Recommendation lands by Q3 2026
predictions.body: By Q3 2026 the Thursday OECD GENAI working-group secretariat procedural note — formalizing the Indo-Pacific cyber-evaluation reciprocity attestation field schema as a draft Recommendation text for member-state circulation in the June 2-6 plenary window — combined with the Thursday cross-continental cohort expansion (the United Arab Emirates Cybersecurity Council and the Israel National Cyber Directorate jointly publishing the first Middle East formal exploratory-observer commitment, Saudi Arabia National Cybersecurity Authority's adjacent-track pre-commitment marking the first GCC adjacent extension, and the cohort's named-candidate count crossing to thirteen formal-plus-observer-plus-exploratory jurisdictions plus the originating UK and EU) and the Thursday Mistral Workflows public-preview shipment of a formal cyber-eval reciprocity attestation matrix supporting all thirteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy field schemas as the first cross-vendor matrix-tier interop deliverable, forces the OECD GENAI working-group to adopt the attestation field schema as a formal OECD Recommendation rather than holding it as a sub-working-group technical note. The trigger is the simultaneous Thursday landing of three structurally complementary moves: the secretariat's procedural note publishes a citable draft Recommendation text with explicit June 2-6 plenary member-state circulation calendar (moving the schema from informal sub-working-group artifact to OECD Recommendation candidate); the cross-continental cohort gains its first Middle East formal entry (UAE) plus its first GCC adjacent track (Saudi Arabia) plus its first jointly-co-published Middle East entry (UAE + Israel) on the same Thursday wire, demonstrating that the perimeter no longer reads as Indo-Pacific-only and pre-empts the most plausible plenary objection that the schema reflects only one regional bloc's interests; and the Mistral Workflows public-preview cross-orchestrator interop matrix ships supporting all thirteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy field schemas as a private-sector lived demonstration that the schema is already an operative multi-vendor procurement primitive ahead of any OECD action. The structural force is procedural rather than political: when the secretariat itself publishes a draft Recommendation text with a named plenary circulation window AND the cohort has already crossed regional-bloc boundaries AND a major private-sector cross-orchestrator interop matrix ships matrix-tier support for the field schemas, the OECD member-state adoption pathway compresses correspondingly because the Recommendation text now functions as a procedural floor — declining adoption would require an affirmative reason from each member-state given the schema's existing multi-vendor uptake. The landing shape: by Q3 2026 the OECD Council adopts the cyber-evaluation reciprocity attestation field schema as a formal OECD Recommendation, at least one additional OECD member-state outside the existing Indo-Pacific cohort (likely Mexico, Chile, Colombia, or Costa Rica from the Latin American track, or one of the Continental European allied-defense industrial-base jurisdictions newly anchored by the Anthropic Thursday Continental defense gating extension) joins the perimeter under the Recommendation umbrella, and at least one hyperscaler agent-registry GA tier cites the OECD Recommendation rather than the underlying bilateral memoranda as the operative tenant-policy schema reference. Bear case is the June 2-6 plenary defers the draft Recommendation text to a fall session pending the FMRB executive order signing posture (so that the OECD Recommendation can be coordinated with a US reciprocity-mirror clause); absent that deferral, Q3 2026 lands the OECD Recommendation as the operative multilateral umbrella for the cyber-eval reciprocity attestation field schema, formally lifting the schema above the Indo-Pacific bilateral-memoranda baseline.

predictions.summary: Thursday's OECD GENAI secretariat note formalizes the cyber-eval reciprocity attestation field schema as a draft Recommendation for the June 2-6 plenary, paired with the cohort's first Middle East and GCC extensions plus Mistral's matrix-tier interop shipment. By Q3 2026 the OECD Council adopts it.
